text_block_list.name: Teio & Dura
text_block_list.text:
Heeeeere we come! 
Challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Brian. We heard you sent a duel challenge 
to the Student Council President.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We won't let you face her, though! 
We'll take her place and take you on 
instead, 
so get ready, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, hold on! Dura!? 
Why are you two racing Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on, Air Groove. 
Why don't we simply watch how this plays 
out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the race began—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...ending in Narita Brian's victory.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*... *pant*...! 
Kgh...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuughhh~...! 
Why did Brian have to win~...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way! It's not over yet! 
Brian's gotta race us one more time! 
We're definitely, absolutely————

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
NOT gonna let you quit the student 
council—!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We found out, you see. 
The reason you joined the student council 
in the 
first place was to face the president, 
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
But if you race the president, find 
satisfaction, 
and decide to leave the council...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It will trouble the president... and our 
vice president, Groovy, as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So race us one more time! 
We're definitely going to beat you next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And when we win, we're gonna tell you: 
"As long as you stay on the council, 
we'll accept your challenges as many times 
as it takes!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...If we do that, you won't quit the 
student council anymore, right, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hahaha! 
Me, quit? Why would I?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not when there's a "future" like this out 
there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...A "future"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
What we nurture in the student council is 
the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And that doesn't just mean the 
underclassmen directly 
involved with us, but every horsegirl who 
walks through our gates.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us pave the way together so that all 
girls 
with grand ambitions may find their 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Though thanks to those lofty ideals of 
yours,

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: we often end up drawing the short straw.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Brian. 
Could it be that you—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The future you guys are building is 
entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're not going to put that on hold, are 
you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian, do you... 
wish to compete against the future itself 
as well?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll take on you, and I'll take 
on whatever future you create.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...So don't let me get bored. 
Keep showing me that future of yours.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. We shall deliver.
